typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	AuditFolder as string (),
	Count as integer (),
	EmailRecipientFailure as string (),
	EmailRecipientSuccess as string (),
	EndDate as timestamp (),
	EndDate_Adhoc as timestamp (),
	FileName as string (),
	FTPFolder as string (),
	OutputFolder as string (),
	ProcessRunDate as timestamp (),
	RowCount as integer (),
	StartDate as timestamp (),
	StartDate_Adhoc as timestamp ()
}

source(output(
		{Request Type} as string,
		Reference_ClaimID as string,
		FileName as string,
		MCOUniqueID as string,
		{Activity Reported Date} as string,
		{Activity Performed Date} as string,
		{First Name} as string,
		{Last Name} as string,
		{Activity ID} as string,
		{Original Transaction ID} as string,
		{Medicaid ID} as string,
		{Activity Source} as string,
		{Transaction ID} as string,
		Reference_Emg_ClaimID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT [Transaction ID_DDMMCCYY] + REPLACE(STR([Transaction ID_SEQ],7),SPACE(1),\'0\') AS [Transaction ID]       ,[MCOUniqueID]       ,[Activity Source]       ,[Medicaid ID]       ,[First Name]       ,[Last Name]       ,[Activity ID]       ,[Request Type]       ,[Activity Performed Date]       ,[Activity Reported Date]       ,[Original Transaction ID]       ,[Reference_ClaimID]       ,[Reference_Emg_ClaimID]       ,[FileName] FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.[EXTRACT].KY_My_Rewards_Extract WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [FileName] = ? ORDER BY 1 ASC',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> AuditFileSource
AuditFileSource sink(input(
		Request_Type as string,
		Reference_ClaimID as string,
		FileName as string,
		MCOUniqueID as string,
		Activity_Reported_Date as string,
		Activity_Performed_Date as string,
		First_Name as string,
		Last_Name as string,
		Activity_ID as string,
		Original_Transaction_ID as string,
		Medicaid_ID as string,
		Activity_Source as string,
		Transaction_ID as string,
		Reference_Emg_ClaimID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Request_Type = {Request Type},
		Reference_ClaimID,
		FileName,
		MCOUniqueID,
		Activity_Reported_Date = {Activity Reported Date},
		Activity_Performed_Date = {Activity Performed Date},
		First_Name = {First Name},
		Last_Name = {Last Name},
		Activity_ID = {Activity ID},
		Original_Transaction_ID = {Original Transaction ID},
		Medicaid_ID = {Medicaid ID},
		Activity_Source = {Activity Source},
		Transaction_ID = {Transaction ID},
		Reference_Emg_ClaimID)) ~> AuditFlatFileDestination
